summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by British American Tobacco p.l.c. reporting internal share transactions by executives under the company's HMRC-approved Share Incentive Plan. No special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic change is involved. The filing discloses only purchases of ordinary shares at a set price per share under the plan. It is not a proxy, tender offer, or restructuring. The appropriate classification is "None" because the event is ordinary insider share dealing, not a corporate action warranting special-situations analysis. No action or watch item is applicable.
